question: Should this ACP node-backed runtime be sponsored for a rebase and storage/security repair, or should maintainers pause or replace this branch?
rationale: The PR is a large new runtime and trust-boundary feature with source-proven blockers, so automation cannot choose the permanent storage model or security acceptance path safely.

options.title: Rebase and repair before merge
options.body: Resolve conflicts, move durable ACP runtime state to an approved SQLite-backed schema, fix the P1/P2 runtime blockers, and require real paired-node proof.

options.title: Accept only as an explicit experiment
options.body: Maintainers could keep the path non-default, but they would still own the JSON storage and gateway-node command-surface risks before merge.

options.title: Pause or replace the branch
options.body: If the rebase and storage redesign would discard most of the branch, pause this PR and open a narrower replacement against current main.

recommendation.title: Rebase and repair before merge
recommendation.body: Resolve conflicts, move durable ACP runtime state to an approved SQLite-backed schema, fix the P1/P2 runtime blockers, and require real paired-node proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest current-main history signal across ACP manager and node-host invoke paths, which are central to the decision.
